legal_shift.case: State of UP v. Lalta Prasad Vaish, SC 9-judge bench, 23-Oct-2024 (8:1)
legal_shift.holding: 'intoxicating liquor' (Entry 8, List II) COVERS industrial/denatured alcohol — overrules Synthetics & Chemicals 1990; states can now regulate and levy fees on the ENA/denatured stream that feeds BOTH potable and fuel output
legal_shift.consequence: regulatory-fee creep is now the structural risk for fuel-ethanol economics — Punjab's Rs 1/BL ethanol regulatory fee (Policy 2025-26 Para 29) is the first mover; MoPNG formally asked for rollback (8-Apr-2025); Haryana + HP flagged with similar levies

cbg_gobardhan_fertiliser.what: CBG plants selling fertiliser — the FCO route that lets Compressed Bio-Gas / GOBARdhan plants sell their fermented digestate as a notified fertiliser, a second revenue leg for the CBG/biofuel business model (FOM is ~20 pct of a CBG plant's feedstock throughput). Researched 2026-07-24 against the primary gazette.
cbg_gobardhan_fertiliser.regulator: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (DA&FW) under the Fertiliser (Inorganic, Organic or Mixed) Control Order, 1985 (FCO) — NOT the Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers

two_moves.1_create_category: Schedule VIII 'Organic Carbon Enhancer' introduced 17-Feb-2025; full FOM (solid) + LFOM (liquid) specs notified 27-Mar-2025 (the 12th amendment to FCO 1985)
two_moves.2_authorise_bulk_sale: under sub-clause (c) of clause 22 of the FCO, serial 'Bulk Sale Notifications' name specific plants and authorise them to sell FOM/LFOM in BULK directly to farmers for 3 years — bypassing the normal fertiliser-dealer licensing chain

cbg_gobardhan_fertiliser.why_it_was_needed: CBG digestate/bio-slurry could not be sold as fertiliser before: FOM kept failing the old 5 pct minimum NPK and the 4mm sieve at 70 pct moisture. Schedule VIII reframes it around SOIL CARBON — the new 'Organic Carbon Enhancer' category DROPS NPK and C:N entirely and is defined on organic-carbon + heavy-metals only. Critics (Down To Earth/CSE) note this relaxes the organic-manure quality norm.
cbg_gobardhan_fertiliser.spec_confirmed_primary_gazette: CG-DL-E-29032025-262118 — 'Fertiliser (Inorganic, Organic or Mixed) (Control) (THIRD) Amendment Order, 2025', issued 27-Mar-2025, publ 29-Mar-2025, Part II Sec 3(ii), Schedule VIII Part A; pulled from egazette.gov.in/WriteReadData/2025/262118.pdf on 2026-07-24 (browser-driven ASP.NET search -> direct PDF URL). NOT the '12th amendment' that secondary sources called it — it is the 3rd Amendment of 2025.

fom_spec_schedule_viii.no_NPK_or_CN: Schedule VIII FOM has NO NPK minimum, NO C:N ratio, NO sieve requirement — defined on carbon + heavy metals only
fom_spec_schedule_viii.correction: 🔴 SUPERSEDES the earlier FACT-tender numbers in this block (which had NPK 1.2 pct / C:N <=30 / sieve / TOC flat-14 / Cr 300 / Cu 50 / pH 6.5-8.4) — those were a DIFFERENT/older FOM standard, not Schedule VIII. Gazette-correct: carbon 12-14 pct, pH 6.0-8.4, Cr 50 / Cu 300, no NPK/C:N/sieve

lfom_spec_schedule_viii.analysis_note: gazette Part C: LFOM parameters estimated on DRY-WEIGHT basis — oven-dry 1000 ml at 105C before analysis
lfom_spec_schedule_viii.correction: 🔴 SUPERSEDES the earlier GeM-2023 numbers (TOC 14 pct 'dry basis', C:N <20, Pb 50). Gazette-correct LFOM: organic carbon 1.5 pct BY WEIGHT (liquid), pH 6.0-8.4, same heavy metals as FOM incl. Pb 100; NO NPK/C:N. The Cr/Cu 'transpose' flag is RESOLVED — both FOM and LFOM are Cr 50 / Cu 300; the old FACT-tender FOM table was the wrong one
lfom_spec_schedule_viii.amendment_naming: the operative instrument is the 3rd Amendment Order 2025 (27-Mar-2025); secondary sources mis-labelled it the '12th amendment' and referenced a later 3-Dec-2025 amendment on sampling/analysis — the SPEC numbers above are from the 27-Mar-2025 primary gazette

cbg_gobardhan_fertiliser.egazette_access: 🔑 egazette.gov.in is a session-token ASP.NET site (curl-hostile: SearchMenu.aspx 302s to error without the session cookie). Route that WORKS: browser-drive the home page's Search postback (__doPostBack('sgzt','')) -> 'Search by Ministry' (btnMinistry) -> set ddlMinistry=5 (Agri & Farmers Welfare) + ddlmonth + ddlyear -> ImgSubmitDetails; each result's download button hits the DIRECT PDF at egazette.gov.in/WriteReadData/<year>/<gid-numeric>.pdf (no session needed for the PDF itself)
